start_here.headline: Start with timeline.
lines: START HERE: timeline.events is the cross-source entry point — one row per real-world event from every source, with timeline.search_text() / timeline.search_text_exact() over the whole corpus.
Then: marts_* for structured domain analysis (finance, contacts, messages, photos, inbox, receipts, calendar, ai_conversations).
Then: base_* for complete, faithful source detail — every timeline row names its source_table + source_pk so you can drill straight back to it.
derived_* holds the modelled facts in between (identity resolution, enrichment, transcripts, ledger history).
